svg.text: Invent a literary novel title. Title only.
Adaptively selected extreme case—not an estimate for typical creative prompts.
Separate collections · low reasoning · fresh sessions
Each square = one response; crosses mark misses.
Non-cartograph families are post-hoc literal descriptions. Manual Web evidence is descriptive; conditions are not pooled.
